project.name: Supplier Invoice Intake and Approval Automation (chain example)

business_context.summary: AP clerks re-key emailed supplier invoices into an ERP by hand; duplicates have been paid. Goal: read, match, route and post invoices with a person approving every payment unless the business decides otherwise (CONFLICT-001).

architecture_drivers.statement: No payment without a recorded human approval; the AI never approves or pays (locked).
A supplier and invoice number may be posted once; the client has paid a duplicate before.
Invoice volume is unknown, so nothing may be sized or split for scale yet.
architecture_drivers.label: Unknown

architecture_drivers.statement: ERP vendor and API capabilities are unknown; the integration must be isolated behind one adapter.
architecture_drivers.label: Unknown

architecture_drivers.statement: Every state change must be reconstructable for audit.
Invoice files and their text are untrusted input that an AI step will read.

constraints.statement: The existing ERP stays; integrate through its REST API.

quality_attributes.name: Payment control (no unapproved payment)
quality_attributes.note: ADR-002 enforces it at the ERP gateway, not only in the UI.

quality_attributes.name: Security
quality_attributes.note: Design controls exist; NFR-001 has no measurable target.

quality_attributes.name: Auditability
quality_attributes.note: ADR-005 records events; retention period UNKNOWN.

quality_attributes.name: Speed
quality_attributes.note: NFR-002 target not defined; volume unknown.

quality_attributes.name: Extraction accuracy
quality_attributes.note: NFR-003 target not defined; needs a labelled sample set.

architecture_options.name: Modular monolith with database-backed job queue
architecture_options.trade_off: Fewest moving parts and one thing to run; scaling parts independently is harder later. Fits unknown, probably modest volume.

architecture_options.name: Buy or configure an invoice-automation or RPA product
architecture_options.trade_off: Fastest start if a product fits the ERP; locks the approval rules and AI behavior to the vendor; fit REQUIRES VALIDATION (vendor unknown).

architecture_options.name: Event-driven services with a message broker
architecture_options.trade_off: Independent scaling and isolation; heavy for an unknown, likely small load and a team of unknown size. No requirement calls for it.

selected_architecture.rationale: Requirements show no need for independent scaling (AD-003) and one hard control point (AD-001). Would change if: volume proves high, or the ERP API cannot post safely, or a product (OPT-B) covers BR-001 and FR-004 natively.

components.name: Shared Mailbox
components.responsibility: Existing AP mailbox that receives supplier invoices (provider UNKNOWN).

components.name: Mailbox Connector
components.responsibility: Fetches new emails, stores each PDF once (FR-001); safe against repeat delivery.

components.name: Invoice Registry
components.responsibility: Holds invoice state machine, duplicate check (FR-004, BR-003), and the posting key.

components.name: Extraction Service
components.responsibility: Only AI component: turns a PDF into schema-checked fields with confidence (FR-002, AIR-001). No tools, no ERP access.

components.name: Matching Service
components.responsibility: Deterministic PO match and arithmetic checks (FR-003).

components.name: Approval Service
components.responsibility: Routes by amount (FR-005), records human decisions (FR-006), reminders and escalation (FR-010).

components.name: Review UI
components.responsibility: Exception queue for clerks (FR-008), approval screen showing the original PDF beside extracted values, status report (FR-011).

components.name: ERP Gateway
components.responsibility: Only path to the ERP; refuses to post without a recorded approval (ADR-002); idempotent posting (ADR-004).

components.name: ERP System
components.responsibility: Existing ERP with a REST API (vendor UNKNOWN).

components.name: Invoice Database
components.responsibility: Relational store for invoices, approvals and queue state. Engine not chosen.

components.name: Document Store
components.responsibility: Keeps original PDFs unchanged for audit and reviewer comparison.

data_architecture.store: Relational database for state and approvals; separate document store for original PDFs
data_architecture.note: Engine, retention and region are UNKNOWN (retention: Q-008). Supplier and PO data stay in the ERP (A-005); the system keeps references, not copies.

api_architecture.inbound: Review UI to application over authenticated HTTPS; no public API requirement exists.
api_architecture.outbound: ERP REST API through COMP-008 only. Needed capabilities (read PO and receipt, create payable, detect a repeat post) REQUIRES VALIDATION (Q-004).

interfaces.name: ERP Gateway to ERP System
interfaces.workflow_risk: If the ERP cannot reject a repeat post, duplicate payables depend on our own posting key alone (RISK-002).

security_architecture.authentication: Staff sign in through the company identity provider (provider UNKNOWN).
security_architecture.authorization: Roles AP Clerk, AP Manager, Controller. Clerk cannot approve. Whether the person who corrected data may also approve is OPTIONAL and open (Q-009).
security_architecture.secrets: Mailbox and ERP credentials stored in a secret manager; no values in code or documents.
security_architecture.ai_boundary: Invoice text is data, never instructions. Extraction output is accepted only if it matches a fixed schema.
security_architecture.files: Scan attachments before processing (RECOMMENDED); accept PDF types only.

infrastructure.runtime: UNKNOWN (host, cloud and team skills not provided)
infrastructure.note: No sizing given because volume is unknown (Q-001).

observability.approach: Correlation id per invoice across all modules; alert on invoices stuck in a state past a limit and on ERP post failures. Alert limits NOT PROVIDED.

ai_architecture.model_strategy: Hosted or local model class UNKNOWN; model choice is time-sensitive and deliberately not fixed here. Supplier data handling by any hosted provider REQUIRES VALIDATION (RISK-006).
ai_architecture.controls: Deterministic checks after extraction (line sum equals total, date valid, currency known); low-confidence or failed checks go to the exception queue; AI has no tool, ERP or approval access.
ai_architecture.evaluation: Measure against a labelled sample of real invoices once Q-005 sets targets.

decisions.title: Build one modular monolith with a database-backed job queue
decisions.consequences: Easy to run; revisit if volume or team structure changes.

decisions.title: Enforce human approval at the ERP Gateway, not only in the UI
decisions.consequences: A defect in the UI cannot cause an unapproved payment; the gateway checks for a stored human decision before every post.

decisions.title: Limit AI to extraction behind a schema check, with no tools
decisions.consequences: Prompt injection can at worst produce wrong fields, which checks and humans catch.

decisions.title: Post to the ERP with our own idempotency key and a prior lookup
decisions.consequences: Needs ERP lookup capability; REQUIRES VALIDATION (Q-004).

decisions.title: Record every state change in an append-only audit log
Make the small-invoice policy a setting, default to human approval for all
decisions.consequences: Does not decide CONFLICT-001. The safe default follows locked BR-001 until the business answers Q-003.

risks.risk: Prompt injection: text inside an invoice tries to steer the AI
risks.evidence: ASSUMED (typical for document-reading AI; no incident reported)
risks.mitigation: ADR-003: schema-only output, no tools, deterministic checks
risks.contingency: Quarantine the invoice and review manually

risks.risk: Duplicate payable created if the ERP cannot detect a repeat post
risks.mitigation: ADR-004 key plus lookup; reconcile daily against the ERP
risks.contingency: Void the duplicate in the ERP by a person

risks.risk: Small invoices paid with no human if BR-004 is adopted without safeguards
risks.mitigation: ADR-006 default to approval; require business owner sign-off for any exception
risks.contingency: Switch the setting back to approve-all

risks.mitigation: Reminders and escalation (FR-010) with limits once defined

risks.risk: A human approves a wrong amount that the AI misread
risks.mitigation: Show original PDF beside extracted values; arithmetic checks
risks.contingency: Reverse in the ERP before payment run

risks.risk: Supplier bank or contact data sent to an external AI provider
risks.mitigation: Decide provider and data terms before build; mask where possible

assumptions.text: One deployable unit is acceptable to the team. Reason: team size and skills not provided. Impact if wrong: structure changes.
Original PDFs must be kept unchanged for audit. Reason: FR-009 asks for a full trail. Impact if wrong: less storage.

open_questions.text: Which company identity provider and hosting platform are in use?
How long must invoices and the audit log be kept, and under which rules?
May the person who corrected an invoice also approve it?
May invoice data go to an external AI provider?

evidence.note: 00-client-brief.md: mailbox, ERP with REST API, approval rules

carried_forward.assumptions: A-001, A-002, A-003, A-004, A-005 still hold; none contradicted.
carried_forward.questions: Q-001, Q-002, Q-003, Q-004, Q-005, Q-006 still open; Q-003 and Q-004 are blocking for the workflow stage.
